tunes_experiment_guide_intro: Experiments are an agent-driven loop for testing setup changes. You drive the car and describe what you feel; Setup Engineer handles setup analysis and records each version.
tunes_experiment_guide_create_body: Choose one car and track, add a base setup, and select what you want to improve. This gives the agent a fixed starting point and a clear focus.
tunes_experiment_guide_chat_body: Use chat beside the version tree. The agent reads the current setup, your symptoms, and experiment history. Ask questions or describe handling problems in plain language.
tunes_experiment_guide_preview_body: The agent proposes specific setup changes and can preview their effect. Nothing is applied until you confirm. Approved changes create a new version in the tree.
tunes_experiment_guide_drive_body: Start Dashboard, drive a consistent stint, then review the recorded laps. Clean, repeatable laps make comparisons and recommendations more useful.
tunes_experiment_guide_compare_body: Open Review laps to compare versions and lap deltas. Keep the better version as your head, then ask the agent for the next focused change. Import past laps when you already have useful history.
tunes_experiment_guide_tip: Best results: change one area at a time, tell the agent what changed between runs, and drive similar fuel and tyre conditions.

dataguide_desc_speed: Current vehicle speed in selected units.
dataguide_desc_throttle_brake: Pedal input as % of full travel (0–100%).
dataguide_desc_steer: Steering wheel angle in degrees, scaled to your steering lock setting.
dataguide_desc_boost: Turbo/supercharger boost pressure in PSI above atmospheric.
dataguide_desc_power_torque: Engine output at the current RPM.
dataguide_desc_fuel: % consumed since lap start · % remaining in tank.
dataguide_desc_balance: Hybrid understeer/oversteer detector. Combines two independent physics signals: yaw rate vs path curvature (ω compared to Aᵧ/V — MoTeC/VBox standard) and front−rear slip angle delta. + = understeer (fronts outrunning rears) · − = oversteer (body yawing past path). Gated by |latG| ≥ 0.25g, so straight-line wheelspin or lockup never counts as balance.
dataguide_desc_grip_ask: Grip Ask uses source-native combined slip where available; physical friction-circle utilisation requires physical slip angle. Forza lateral slip remains a dimensionless ratio, not degrees.
dataguide_traction_spin: SPIN — past peak, longitudinal axis dominant
dataguide_traction_slide: SLIDE — past peak, lateral axis dominant
dataguide_traction_lock: LOCK — wheel stopped or dragging under braking
dataguide_desc_ratio: Wheel speed vs ground speed. High ratio = wheelspin/lockup. State: nominal <10% · caution <30% · critical beyond.
dataguide_desc_angle: Angle between wheel heading and direction of travel. Peak mechanical grip is typically 6–12° (speed-dependent). Thresholds scale down at low speed.
dataguide_desc_rotation: Wheel angular velocity in rad/s. Spikes sharply during wheelspin.
dataguide_desc_wear_rate: % of tire worn per second at the current intensity, measured over the last lap.
dataguide_desc_load: Weight distribution. Lon 50% = balanced front/rear · Lat 50% = balanced left/right. Shifts during acceleration, braking, and cornering.
